unchanged.reconciliation-drift-incident-listener: Keeps default. docker-compose.yml sets no tenant for reconciliation-drift-svc, whose _configured_tenant_id() (services/reconciliation-drift/main.py) reads PANTHEON_TENANT_ID or RECONCILIATION_DRIFT_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID, else 'default'. The listener (incident_listener.py) must send the tenant the svc accepts; a BFF fallback here would diverge from the svc and trigger its 400 'X-Tenant-Id is required' rejection loop.

isolation: Each worker still processes exactly one configured tenant; no tenant rule changed.
